import java.util.Collections; import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { Map<String, String> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put("P1", "Warehouse"); initial.put("P2", "Transit"); final DelegatingParcelTracker tracker = new DelegatingParcelTracker(initial); Thread t1 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { tracker.assignPosition("P1", "Delivered"); System.out.println("P1 position: " + tracker.retrievePosition("P1")); } }); Thread t2 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { Map<String, String> snapshot = tracker.getAllPositionsStatic(); System.out.println("Snapshot: " + snapshot); } }); t1.start(); t2.start(); try { t1.join(); t2.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } } class DelegatingParcelTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, String> positions; public DelegatingParcelTracker(Map<String, String> initial) { this.positions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } public String retrievePosition(String packageId) { return positions.get(packageId); } public boolean assignPosition(String packageId, String position) { if (!positions.containsKey(packageId)) { return false; } positions.put(packageId, position); return true; } public Map<String, String> getAllPositionsLive() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(positions); } public Map<String, String> getAllPositionsStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(positions)); } }

import java.util.Collections; import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { Map<String, String> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put("R1", "Zone A"); initial.put("R2", "Zone B"); final DelegatingRobotTracker tracker = new DelegatingRobotTracker(initial); Thread t1 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { tracker.modifyCoordinates("R1", "Zone C"); System.out.println("R1 coordinates: " + tracker.checkCoordinates("R1")); } }); Thread t2 = new Thread(new Runnable() { @Override public void run() { Map<String, String> snapshot = tracker.getAllCoordinatesStatic(); System.out.println("Snapshot: " + snapshot); } }); t1.start(); t2.start(); try { t1.join(); t2.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } } class DelegatingRobotTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, String> coordinates; public DelegatingRobotTracker(Map<String, String> initial) { this.coordinates = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } public String checkCoordinates(String robotId) { return coordinates.get(robotId); } public boolean modifyCoordinates(String robotId, String coord) { if (!coordinates.containsKey(robotId)) { return false; } coordinates.put(robotId, coord); return true; } public Map<String, String> getAllCoordinatesLive() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(coordinates); } public Map<String, String> getAllCoordinatesStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(coordinates)); } }

import java.util.*; class Point { public final int x; public final int y; Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } } class DelegatingVehicleTracker { private final java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Point> locations; DelegatingVehicleTracker(Map<String, Point> initial) { locations = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } Map<String, Point> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(locations); } Point getLocation(String id) { return locations.get(id); } void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { if (locations.replace(id, new Point(x, y)) == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); } Map<String, Point> getLocationsAsStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(locations)); } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, Point> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new Point(0, 0)); final DelegatingVehicleTracker tracker = new DelegatingVehicleTracker(initial); Thread t1 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 1, 1); } }); Thread t2 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(1)); } }); Thread t3 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocations(); } }); Thread t4 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocationsAsStatic(); } }); Thread t5 = new Thread(new Runnable() { public void run() { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(2)); } }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t3.start(); t4.start(); t5.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); t3.join(); t4.join(); t5.join(); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class Point { public final int x; public final int y; Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } } class DelegatingVehicleTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Point> locations; DelegatingVehicleTracker(Map<String, Point> initial) { locations = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } Point getLocation(String id) { return locations.get(id); } void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { if (locations.replace(id, new Point(x, y)) == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); } Map<String, Point> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(locations); } Map<String, Point> getLocationsAsStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(locations)); } } public class Main { static DelegatingVehicleTracker tracker; public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, Point> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new Point(0, 0)); tracker = new DelegatingVehicleTracker(initial); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 1, 1); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocationsAsStatic(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }
